content: Piedra is a fungal infection that affects the hair. It is classified into two types: white piedra and black piedra. Under a magnification of 100x, a photomicrograph reveals the pathological morphology of a primate hair shaft affected by black piedra, also known as trichosporosis. This condition is caused by the fungal organism Piedraia hortae. The image is sourced from the Public Health Image Library (PHIL). Another photomicrograph shows a hair shaft infected with black piedra, caused by Piedraia hortae. This image is also from the Public Health Image Library (PHIL). A separate photomicrograph, magnified 475x, displays the mycelium of the fungus Piedraia hortae. This image is provided by the Public Health Image Library (PHIL). Additionally, a plate culture of Piedraia hortae, strain A272, is shown. This culture image is sourced from the Public Health Image Library (PHIL).
